title: Groups
description: Tabbed window groups and their title bars

options.label: Group automatically
options.description: Put newly opened windows into the focused group

options.label: Insert after current
options.description: Place new windows after the current tab instead of at the end

options.label: Focus removed window
options.description: Focus a window after it leaves a group

options.label: Drag into group
options.description: Whether dragging a window onto a group merges it

options.label: Merge groups by dragging
options.description: Allow dragging one group into another

options.label: Merge groups on title bar
options.description: Merge groups when one is dragged onto the other title bar

options.label: Merge floating into tiled
options.description: Allow dragging a floating window into a tiled group title bar

options.label: Group on move to workspace
options.description: Merge windows into the target workspace group when moved there

options.label: Active border
options.description: Border color of the active group

options.label: Inactive border
options.description: Border color of inactive groups

options.label: Active locked border
options.description: Border color of the active locked group

options.label: Inactive locked border
options.description: Border color of inactive locked groups

options.label: Show title bar
options.description: Show a tab bar on each group

options.label: Show window titles
options.description: Draw window titles in the tab bar

options.label: Hide for single windows
options.description: Hide the tab bar when the group has one window

options.label: Bar height
options.description: Height of the title bar

options.label: Font
options.description: Font for titles. Empty uses the default font

options.label: Font size
options.description: Size of the title text

options.label: Active font weight
options.description: Weight of the active title text, such as normal or bold

options.label: Inactive font weight
options.description: Weight of inactive title text

options.label: Stacked bar
options.description: Show the tabs as a vertical stack

options.label: Scroll to switch tab
options.description: Scrolling over the bar changes the active window

options.label: Middle click to close
options.description: Middle click a tab to close its window

options.label: Blur background
options.description: Blur behind the title bar

options.label: Decoration priority
options.description: Order of the bar among other window decorations

options.label: Active tab
options.description: Color of the active tab

options.label: Inactive tab
options.description: Color of inactive tabs

options.label: Active locked tab
options.description: Color of the active tab in a locked group

options.label: Inactive locked tab
options.description: Color of inactive tabs in a locked group

options.label: Text color
options.description: Color of tab titles

options.label: Inactive text color
options.description: Color of inactive tab titles. Empty uses the text color

options.label: Active locked text color
options.description: Color of the active title in a locked group. Empty uses the text color

options.label: Inactive locked text color
options.description: Color of inactive titles in a locked group. Empty uses the text color

options.label: Gradient tabs
options.description: Draw tabs with gradients

options.label: Bar rounding
options.description: Corner radius of the bar

options.label: Bar corner shape
options.description: Curvature of the bar corners. 2 is a circle

options.label: Round only outer edges
options.description: Round just the outer edges of the bar

options.label: Tab rounding
options.description: Corner radius of tab gradients

options.label: Tab corner shape
options.description: Curvature of tab gradient corners

options.label: Round only outer tab edges
options.description: Round just the outer edges of tab gradients

options.label: Gap between tabs
options.description: Space between tabs

options.label: Gap to window
options.description: Space between the tabs and the window

options.label: Keep upper gap
options.description: Keep the gap above the tab bar

options.label: Indicator height
options.description: Height of the colored tab indicator

options.label: Indicator gap
options.description: Space between the indicator and the title

options.label: Text offset
options.description: Vertical shift of the title text

options.label: Text padding
options.description: Horizontal padding of the title text
